design_overview: UniStudy is a modern, student-focused mobile application designed for seamless study note sharing and collaborative learning. The design prioritizes clarity, quick access to content, and intuitive navigation. The interface uses a clean card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, making it easy for students to discover, share, and organize study materials. The color scheme reflects academic professionalism while maintaining approachability. All screens are designed for touch-first interaction with clear CTAs and realistic user flows.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Main landing screen showing recent notes, trending content, and quick actions

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, contains app logo 'UniStudy' on left, notification bell icon on right, height 60px
key_components.interaction: Bell icon navigates to notifications screen

key_components.name: Welcome Section
key_components.styling: Gradient background (primary to secondary), white text, rounded corners 16px, padding 20px, displays 'Welcome back, [Name]' and current university
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, informational display

key_components.name: Quick Actions Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal row of 2 buttons: 'Upload Notes' (primary blue, white text) and 'Create Group' (white background, primary border), rounded 12px, equal width
key_components.interaction: Upload Notes navigates to upload screen, Create Group navigates to group creation

key_components.name: Trending Notes Section Header
key_components.styling: Bold text 'Trending Notes', dark gray color, 18px font size, margin bottom 12px
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive label

key_components.name: Trending Notes List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of note cards, each card has white background, shadow, rounded 12px, contains note title, subject tag, rating stars, download count, and thumbnail
key_components.interaction: Tapping any card navigates to note detail screen

key_components.name: Note Card Item
key_components.styling: White card with left-aligned thumbnail (80x80px), title in bold, subject badge (blue pill shape), 5-star rating display, download icon with count, padding 16px
key_components.interaction: Tap to view full note details and download options

key_components.name: Recent Activity Section
key_components.styling: Light gray background card, rounded 12px, shows 'Your Recent Activity' header and list of 3 recent downloads/uploads with timestamps
key_components.interaction: Tapping items navigates to respective note or group

key_components.name: Suggested Groups Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Suggested Groups' header, horizontal scrollable row of group cards showing group name, member count, and subject
key_components.interaction: Swipe horizontally to browse, tap to view group details

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, white background, shadow on top, 4 icons with labels: Home (active - primary color), Search, Groups, Profile, height 70px
key_components.interaction: Tap icons to navigate between main sections

screens.user_flow: Entry point after login → User can upload notes, create groups, browse trending content, or navigate to other sections via bottom nav

screens.name: Search & Browse
screens.purpose: Search and filter study notes and groups by subject, course, or keywords

key_components.name: Search Header
key_components.styling: White background, contains back button on left, 'Search' title centered, filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to previous screen, filter icon opens filter modal

key_components.name: Search Input Bar
key_components.styling: White rounded input field with search icon on left, placeholder 'Search notes, groups, or courses...', light gray border, height 48px, margin 16px
key_components.interaction: Tap to activate keyboard, typing triggers real-time search results

key_components.name: Filter Chips Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row of filter chips: 'All', 'Notes', 'Groups', 'My University', rounded pill shape, selected chip has primary background
key_components.interaction: Tap to toggle filter category, updates results below

key_components.name: Recent Searches
key_components.styling: Light background section with 'Recent Searches' header, list of 3-5 previous search terms with clock icon, each item tappable
key_components.interaction: Tap to re-run previous search query

key_components.name: Popular Subjects Section
key_components.styling: Grid layout of subject cards (2 columns), each card shows subject name, note count, and icon, colorful backgrounds, rounded 12px
key_components.interaction: Tap subject card to filter results by that subject

key_components.name: Search Results List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of mixed results (notes and groups), each item has icon indicating type, title, metadata, and chevron right icon
key_components.interaction: Tap result to navigate to detail screen (note or group)

key_components.name: Result Item Card
key_components.styling: White card with left icon (document or group), title, subtitle (course code or member count), rating/metadata on right, divider between items
key_components.interaction: Tap to view full details

key_components.name: No Results State
key_components.styling: Centered empty state with illustration, 'No results found' message, suggestion text, and 'Clear Filters' button
key_components.interaction: Clear Filters button resets all active filters

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, Search icon active (primary color), other icons gray
key_components.interaction: Navigate between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom nav → User searches or browses → Filters results → Taps item to view details → Can navigate back or to other sections

screens.name: Note Detail View
screens.purpose: Display full information about a study note including preview, ratings, and download options

key_components.name: Detail Header
key_components.styling: White background with back button left, share icon and bookmark icon right, shadow below
key_components.interaction: Back returns to previous screen, share opens share sheet, bookmark saves note

key_components.name: Note Preview Image
key_components.styling: Full-width preview image or document thumbnail, aspect ratio 16:9, rounded bottom corners 16px
key_components.interaction: Tap to view full-screen preview

key_components.name: Note Title Section
key_components.styling: White card with note title (bold, 24px), subject badge, course code, upload date, and uploader name with avatar
key_components.interaction: Uploader name is tappable, navigates to user profile

key_components.name: Stats Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal row showing 3 stats: rating (stars + number), downloads (icon + count), file size, evenly spaced, light background
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Description' header and note description text, expandable if long, padding 16px
key_components.interaction: Tap 'Read more' to expand full description

key_components.name: Tags Section
key_components.styling: Row of tag pills with light blue background, rounded, showing topics like 'Midterm', 'Chapter 5', etc.
key_components.interaction: Tap tag to search for related notes

key_components.name: Ratings & Reviews Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Ratings & Reviews' header, average rating display, rating breakdown bars, and list of recent reviews with user avatars
key_components.interaction: Scroll to view all reviews, tap 'Write Review' button to add rating

key_components.name: Review Item
key_components.styling: Review card with user avatar left, name, star rating, review text, and timestamp, divider between reviews
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display

key_components.name: Download Button
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom primary button, full width minus margins, 'Download Note' text, white text on primary blue, height 56px, rounded 12px, shadow
key_components.interaction: Tap to download file, shows loading state then success confirmation

screens.user_flow: Accessed from search results or home trending list → User reviews note details and ratings → Downloads note or bookmarks for later → Can share or return to browse

screens.name: Study Groups
screens.purpose: Browse, join, and manage study groups for collaborative learning

key_components.name: Groups Header
key_components.styling: White background, 'Study Groups' title centered, plus icon right for creating new group
key_components.interaction: Plus icon navigates to create group screen

key_components.name: Tab Selector
key_components.styling: Segmented control with 2 tabs: 'My Groups' and 'Discover', active tab has primary background, inactive is gray
key_components.interaction: Tap to switch between user's groups and browsable groups

key_components.name: Search Groups Input
key_components.styling: White rounded search bar with search icon, placeholder 'Search groups by subject or course...', margin 16px
key_components.interaction: Tap to search, typing filters group list

key_components.name: Filter Options Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal scroll of filter chips: 'All', 'Open Groups', 'My University', 'By Subject', rounded pills
key_components.interaction: Tap to filter group list by criteria

key_components.name: My Groups List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of group cards, each card shows group name, subject, member count, admin badge if applicable, last activity timestamp
key_components.interaction: Tap group card to view group detail and shared notes

key_components.name: Group Card Item
key_components.styling: White card with group icon/avatar left, group name bold, subject tag, member count with user icon, 'Open' or 'Closed' badge, chevron right
key_components.interaction: Tap to navigate to group detail screen

key_components.name: Discover Groups List
key_components.styling: Similar to My Groups but includes 'Join' button on each card, shows group description preview
key_components.interaction: Tap 'Join' to request membership, tap card for details

key_components.name: Join Group Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button with 'Join' text, rounded 8px, positioned right side of group card
key_components.interaction: Tap to join open group immediately or request to join closed group

key_components.name: Empty State Card
key_components.styling: Centered card with illustration, 'No groups yet' message, 'Create your first group' button
key_components.interaction: Button navigates to create group screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, Groups icon active (primary color)
key_components.interaction: Navigate between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom nav → User views their groups or discovers new ones → Joins groups or creates new group → Taps group to view shared content and members

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: Display user information, uploaded notes, group memberships, and account settings

key_components.name: Profile Header
key_components.styling: Gradient background (primary to secondary), white text, contains settings icon top right
key_components.interaction: Settings icon navigates to settings screen

key_components.name: User Avatar Section
key_components.styling: Centered circular avatar (120px), user name below (white, bold, 24px), university name (white, 16px), edit profile button
key_components.interaction: Edit profile button navigates to profile edit screen

key_components.name: Stats Row
key_components.styling: White card with 3 stat columns: Notes Uploaded, Groups Joined, Total Downloads, each with number and label, dividers between
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display

key_components.name: Content Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented control with 3 tabs: 'My Notes', 'Saved', 'Activity', active tab underlined with primary color
key_components.interaction: Tap to switch between content views

key_components.name: My Notes List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of user's uploaded notes, each card shows thumbnail, title, subject, downloads, rating, edit/delete icons
key_components.interaction: Tap note to view details, tap edit to modify, tap delete to remove

key_components.name: Note Management Card
key_components.styling: White card with note thumbnail left, title and metadata center, action icons right (edit, trash), padding 12px
key_components.interaction: Swipe left reveals delete option, tap edit icon to modify note

key_components.name: Saved Notes List
key_components.styling: List of bookmarked notes from other users, similar card layout to My Notes but with bookmark icon instead of edit

key_components.name: Activity Feed
key_components.styling: Timeline-style list showing recent actions: uploads, downloads, group joins, ratings given, with timestamps and icons
key_components.interaction: Tap activity item to navigate to related content

key_components.name: Quick Actions Card
key_components.styling: White card with list of action items: Upload New Note, Create Group, Invite Friends, each with icon left and chevron right
key_components.interaction: Tap action to navigate to respective screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, Profile icon active (primary color)
key_components.interaction: Navigate between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom nav → User views their content and stats → Manages uploaded notes → Accesses saved content → Can navigate to settings or upload new content

key_components.name: Title Input

key_components.interaction: Tap to enter note title, required field

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line text area with label 'Description', placeholder 'Describe what these notes cover...', height 120px, scrollable
key_components.interaction: Tap to enter detailed description, optional field

key_components.name: Subject Selector
key_components.styling: Dropdown input with label 'Subject', shows selected subject or placeholder 'Select subject', chevron down icon right
key_components.interaction: Tap to open subject selection modal with searchable list

key_components.name: Course Code Input
key_components.styling: Text input with label 'Course Code (Optional)', placeholder 'e.g., MATH 201', uppercase transformation
key_components.interaction: Tap to enter course code, optional field

key_components.name: Tags Input
key_components.styling: Chip input field with label 'Tags', shows added tags as removable pills, placeholder 'Add tags...'

key_components.name: Visibility Toggle

key_components.name: Share to Groups Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Share to Groups (Optional)' header, list of user's groups with checkboxes

key_components.name: Upload Button
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom primary button, 'Upload Note' text, full width minus margins, height 56px, disabled state if required fields empty

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All touch targets minimum 44x44px. Layouts use flexible containers and spacing that adapt to screen height. Bottom navigation fixed for thumb-zone accessibility. Horizontal scrolling used sparingly for secondary content. Typography scales appropriately on larger devices. Tablet layouts (768px+) use two-column layouts where appropriate.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios meet 4.5:1 for text. Icons paired with text labels. Form inputs have clear labels and error states. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Focus indicators visible for keyboard navigation. Alternative text for all images. Error messages clear and actionable. Support for system font scaling.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability without distraction. Button press states with 0.1s scale animation. Screen transitions use 0.3s slide or fade. List items fade in on scroll with stagger effect. Pull-to-refresh with elastic bounce. Loading states use skeleton screens or spinner. Success actions show checkmark animation. Modal overlays fade in with backdrop. Swipe gestures have follow-through animation. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style for navigation and actions. Icons from allowed set: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. Icon size 24px for navigation, 20px for inline actions. Primary color for active states, gray for inactive. Icons always paired with labels in navigation. Stroke width 2px for visual consistency.
